### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What**: the name `cylindrical` is accepted and builds a coordinate whose `reset` is empty. **Switch**: YAML
`geometry.type: cylindrical`. **Default**: off. **Requires**: nothing. **Order**: none; no metric is built.
**Defining equation**: none.
:::

`CoordinateImpl::create` maps `cylindrical` to `CylindricalImpl`, but its `reset` does nothing and the source file that
would define it is disabled by its suffix (`cylindrical.cpp_`). No widths, centres, areas or volumes are built. The
type is recorded here so that a reader who meets the name knows it does not work.

### Derivation

Not applicable: there is no implemented metric. The disabled file holds an unfinished vector transform, starting with
`vec_from_cartesian` ([`cylindrical.cpp_`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/coord/cylindrical.cpp_)),
which is not compiled.

### Numerical method
